# Foresight Atlas

> A private directory and programming calendar for the Foresight Institute. Agents may read only what the signed-in person can see. There is no public roster and no write API.

Atlas is two layers. A community account sees community profiles, the team, fellows who opted in, and events. A fellow, grantee, prize winner, or nodee sees the inner atlas. Installing a connector does not cross that line.

## Agents

- [Foresight Atlas skill](https://atlas.foresight.org/agents/foresight-atlas/SKILL.md): how to connect, what you may ask, and what you must not do
- MCP: https://atlas.foresight.org/api/assistant/mcp
- Sign-in is OAuth in the browser. The agent never receives a password
- Tools are read-only: my_profile, my_rsvps, my_subgraph, upcoming_events, open_to_meet, people_by_focus

## People

- [Atlas](https://atlas.foresight.org/): map, programming, and sign-in
- [Foresight Institute](https://www.foresight.org/)
- [Fellowship](https://foresight.org/engage/fellowship/)
- [Grants](https://foresight.org/engage/grants/)
- [Foresight on Index](https://index.network/l/6c06ee69-4e7c-45ba-882c-b07653e1f3f9): mutual introductions only. Joining does not open the fellow atlas, and the roster is not uploaded

## Boundaries

- Do not scrape or republish the directory
- Do not invent contact details
- The only public intent is one sentence, "currently looking for," written by the person
- Node memory stays on the inner atlas and is not in the connector
